No new dependencies or unrelated changes. Use available Rust validation (rustc --test if no Cargo manifest). arguments.content:
# widget

Build with `rustc src/main.rs -o widget`.

Run `./widget` to print the aligned fruit counts, or `./widget --csv` to
export CSV to stdout:

```csv
fruit,count
apples,3
pears,5
plums,2
```

Run tests with `rustc --test src/main.rs -o /tmp/widget-tests && /tmp/widget-tests`.
